basic_info.description: Welcome to the sunny corner of York and 21st Street. This exceptional home offers a newly rebuilt structure showcasing the highest level of contemporary interiors while respecting the period architecture and heritage of the Queen Anne exterior. The just completed multi-year development offers a two-level top floor, 3BR/3BA unit with a blend of stone, glass, wood, oversized eight foot doors, high ceilings and natural light to create a peaceful residence. Inside the entry you'll find an open entertaining space that highlights the turret corner. The chef's kitchen features stainless appliances by Thermador and Liebherr, a breakfast counter and plenty of cabinetry. The massive master suite features a separate changing room and closet, bath with book-matched stone walls, dual showers, oversized soaking tub and double vanity. One the second level is a media den, large bedroom and a private deck with western views. Situated in the vibrant Mission District, you are just steps away from renowned restaurants, cafes, boutiques, entertainment and picturesque parks.
